coverage.destination_weight_rule: home region share * grid TIMS trips / ALL region TIMS trips
coverage.coverage_rule: minimal prefix covers >=99% of service eligible original weights; also report national share
coverage.service_rule: 60km hub road distance per grid; regions with no eligible grid excluded; regional day-trip scope assumption
coverage.resolution: TIMS 500m center; no jitter because matrix supports centers only
coverage.time_rule: 2026-10 Pocheon-origin living-move purpose 3 start hours; 12..21 KST; uniform within hour

calibration.model: training OD median Kakao / OSRM duration multiplier
limitations: Future API estimates are not observed meter receipts.
Single robust global multiplier applied to every ordered leg; hourly validation is descriptive, no traffic clock in matcher.
Distance unchanged. Toll/border/instantaneous slow-speed clocks not reconstructed.
Origin Pocheon uses Pocheon proxy; all other sample origins use existing Seoul proxy, not a full national tariff catalogue.

coverage.participation_rule: Base 100 requests/day is a scenario assumption, not observed students; 50/100/150 requests represent 50/100/150% participation.

exclude_intra_pocheon.rule: Zero intra-Pocheon destination weight and renormalize; hold 100 requests/day and marginal hours fixed
